verdict.rationale: Riveter is API-first, so it can be driven headlessly. The docs describe a programmatic REST API (openapi.yaml) and an official Go SDK that handles auth, retries, long-poll waiting (wait_for_result) and pagination. Webhook callbacks on run completion and guardrails such as dry_run credit estimates and max_credits caps (422 refusal) suit unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: no first-party CLI or CI-specific integration guide/examples, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
